name: IIS - Performance Snapshot
description: The IIS - Performance Snapshot Dashboard provides detailed information on your IIS infrastructure integrity and performance. Dashboard panels show details on Web Service uptime, active connections, requests, user activity, and total bytes transferred. Panels also provide HTTP Service Request Queues details, such as arrivals, queue size, cache hit rate, and rejection rate.
title: IIS - Performance Snapshot

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/iis* webserver_system=iis webserver_farm={{webserver_farm}} Win32_PerfFormattedData_W3SVC_WebService ServiceUptime | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as iis_log_message
| parse field=iis_log_message "Name = \"*\";" as Name
| parse field=iis_log_message "ServiceUptime = *;" as ServiceUptime
| withtime ServiceUptime 
| most_recent(ServiceUptime_withtime) as ServiceUptime by Name
| ServiceUptime / (60*60*24) as ServiceUptimeDays
| sort by ServiceUptimeDays, Name asc
| fields -ServiceUptime

_sourceCategory = Labs/iis* webserver_system=iis webserver_farm={{webserver_farm}} Win32_PerfFormattedData_W3SVC_WebService TotalMethodRequestsPersec | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as iis_log_message
| parse field=iis_log_message "Name = \"*\";" as Name
| parse field=iis_log_message "TotalMethodRequestsPersec = *;" as TotalMethodRequestsPersec
| withtime TotalMethodRequestsPersec 
| most_recent(TotalMethodRequestsPersec_withtime) as Current, min(TotalMethodRequestsPersec) as Min, max(TotalMethodRequestsPersec) as Max, avg(TotalMethodRequestsPersec) as Avg by Name
| sort by Current, Name asc
